name: data-elements
description: An embedded runtime for persistent, editable semantic business artifacts.

scripts.build:packages: turbo run build --filter='./packages/*' && bun run check:source-pollution
scripts.release:check: bun run build:packages && bun run --cwd apps/studio build && bun test packages/cli/index.test.ts && bun scripts/check-npm-release.ts
scripts.registry:build: bun scripts/check-registry-determinism.ts && bunx --bun shadcn@4.17.0 build registry/generated/registry.json --output apps/docs/.registry
scripts.test: bun run check:source-pollution && bun run registry:build && turbo run test && bun test scripts/contract-parity.test.ts scripts/evaluation-manifest.test.ts scripts/server-boundaries.test.ts scripts/registry.test.ts scripts/registry-install.test.ts 'apps/docs/src/app/api/health/route.test.ts' 'apps/docs/src/app/r/[name]/route.test.ts'
